description: Modify an existing segment's name and/or filter definition. Call this after nevent_get_segment to inspect the current definition before changing it. At least one of name or definition must be provided. After update, call nevent_segment_preview to confirm the new audience count before scheduling a campaign.

definition.description: Replacement segment DSL. The full definition is replaced when provided. Criteria in the same stanza are OR-combined: a fan matches the stanza if ANY criterion matches. Stanzas are AND-combined: a fan must match EVERY stanza. Omit to leave the existing definition unchanged.

stanzas.description: Array of stanzas. Stanzas are AND-combined: a fan must match EVERY stanza. Criteria inside one stanza are OR-combined, so a fan matching ANY of them matches that stanza.

criteria.description: Criteria in the same stanza are OR-combined: a fan matches the stanza if ANY criterion matches. Stanzas are AND-combined, so a fan must match EVERY stanza.

criterion_id.description: Criterion identifier from nevent_segmentation_criteria. Examples: total_spent, attended_event, user_gender, user_age, campaign_opened, nevent_temperature

filters.description: Only needed for user_custom_field criterion. Pass { "property_name": "field_name" } to specify which custom field.

id.description: Optional stable ID for UI/cross-request correlation. If omitted, the MCP client auto-generates one before sending to the API.

modifiers.description:
ADVANCED: Usually OMIT this field entirely. Only include when the user explicitly asks for:
- "at least X times" → { frequency: { count: X, operator: "gte" } }
- "in the last X days" → { time_range: { value: X, unit: "days" } } (value MUST be > 0; unit is one of days, weeks, months, years)
If not asked for frequency or recency, DO NOT include modifiers.

operator.description:
Comparison operator. Rules by data type:
- ENTITY: "is" and "is_not" accept a single string ID OR an array of string IDs (valueType=array per API). "is_set", "is_not_set" also supported.
- TEXT: "eq", "neq", "contains", "starts_with", "ends_with", "is_set", "is_not_set"
- NUMBER/CURRENCY: "eq", "neq", "gt", "gte", "lt", "lte", "is_set", "is_not_set"
- BOOLEAN: "is_true", "is_false". NEVER use "eq" with "true"/"false" strings.
- DATE: "before", "after", "between", "eq", "is_set", "is_not_set"

value.description:
Value to match. IMPORTANT rules:
- ENTITY operators (is/is_not): accepts a single string ID OR an array of string IDs (e.g. "event_123" or ["event_1", "event_2"]).
- NUMBER: must be a number (not string)
- BOOLEAN operators (is_true/is_false): no value needed, omit this field.
- DATE "between": array of 2 ISO date strings [start, end]

id.description: Optional stable ID for the stanza. If omitted, the MCP client auto-generates one before sending to the API. Provide your own only if you need stable references across requests.

name.description: New human-readable name for the segment. Omit to leave unchanged.

segment_id.description: Identifier of the segment to update. Use nevent_list_segments to get valid segment IDs.

name: nevent_update_segment
